drug_class: Kinase inhibitor (specifically a VEGFR inhibitor / targeted cancer therapy)
purpose: Fruquintinib is used to treat adults with colorectal cancer that has spread to other parts of the body (metastatic colorectal cancer). It is used when other cancer treatments have already been tried and have stopped working. It helps slow down or stop the growth and spread of the cancer.
how_it_works: Cancer tumors need to grow new blood vessels to get the nutrients they need to survive and spread. Fruquintinib blocks certain proteins called VEGFRs (vascular endothelial growth factor receptors) that signal the body to build these new blood vessels. By blocking these signals, the medication essentially cuts off the tumor's blood supply, helping to starve and slow the cancer.
common_side_effects: Some of the most common side effects include high blood pressure, feeling very tired or weak, diarrhea, decreased appetite, mouth sores, hoarse voice or voice changes, hand-foot syndrome (redness, pain, or peeling on palms and soles), stomach pain, and low levels of certain blood cells. You may also notice protein in your urine.
warnings: This medication can cause serious high blood pressure — your blood pressure will need to be checked regularly. It can increase the risk of bleeding, blood clots, and problems with wound healing, so tell your doctor before any surgery. It may cause liver problems, so blood tests will monitor your liver. It can harm an unborn baby, so effective birth control is very important during treatment and for a period after. Do not breastfeed while taking this medication. Let your doctor know right away if you have unusual bleeding, severe stomach pain, chest pain, or difficulty breathing.
typical_dosing: The usual dose is 5 mg taken by mouth once a day for 21 days in a row, followed by 7 days off (a rest period). This 28-day cycle is then repeated. The capsule should be taken at the same time each day, with or without food. Do not crush or chew the capsule — swallow it whole. Your doctor may lower your dose if you have side effects.
